subject.title: fix(googlechat): fall back to text link when remote media upload fails with 403

question: Should maintainers repair this member-authored PR as the canonical Google Chat app-auth media fallback, or choose one of the sibling PRs instead?
rationale: The bug is real and this PR covers the right surfaces, but the branch is dirty, has repairable correctness/security blockers, and overlaps with other open candidate implementations.

options.title: Repair This PR As Canonical
options.body: Refresh this branch, narrow the upload-scope detector, preserve action send metadata, and use it as the canonical fix for the linked issue.

options.title: Choose A Sibling PR
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers prefer another open implementation that becomes mergeable, proof-accepted, and covers all three media paths.

options.title: Defer To User OAuth Work
options.body: Leave this workaround unmerged only if maintainers decide the broader Google Chat user-OAuth issue should be the sole path for media uploads.
